summary: This Form 6-K was filed by Blue Moon Metals Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, to provide notice of its annual general and special meeting of shareholders scheduled for July 30, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: receiving audited financials, fixing board size at eight, electing directors, appointing MNP LLP as auditor, and considering special resolutions for a corporate continuance from British Columbia to Ontario, adjusting director number authority, and approving an amended share compensation plan. This is a standard management information circular and proxy solicitation, not a special situation event. No price, premium, or deal terms are present.
